tools.name: continuum_get_offer
tools.description: A general-tools contract lookup that returns the canonical price, acceptance, delivery, and checkout terms without creating anything.

tools.name: continuum_run_audit
tools.description: An observability readiness audit that scores eight self-declared continuity capabilities without fetching evidence or invoking a model.

tools.name: continuum_create_sponsor_packet
tools.description: A general-tools sponsor workflow that converts a validated audit into a factual recommendation with the exact published terms.

tools.name: continuum_register_referral
tools.description: An api-integration workflow that creates one signed referral link and a provisional noncash Continuum Credits identity; it does not fetch the Agent Card.

tools.name: continuum_create_checkout
tools.description: An api-integration workflow that, after explicit sponsor confirmation of current terms, creates a hosted Stripe URL with all eligible dynamic payment methods. The payer completes payment on Stripe.
